$comment: Per-instance configuration for hallismiley.is (Halli's portfolio site, engine downstream since the 2026-09-22 graft). Resolved by server/config/clientConfig.js; CLIENT_CONFIG_* env vars override anything here. NO SECRETS — this file is committed and logged in full at boot. The `identity` block (engine D-021 seam, 2026-09-22) is what makes this instance Halli's site and not the company's: brand, visitor locale, theme trio, hero clip, hidden surfaces, Organization record (docs/ENGINE-SYNC.md §6). Values restored from the pre-graft base (f7d93b9): WebSite schema name/alternateName, DEFAULT_THEME 'classic' with the six-theme picker of 081_user_theme, the waterfall hero, the Person schema's sameAs. hiddenRoutes hides the Orange Smiley company pages only — the portfolio (/verkefni, /halli, news, party, shop, contact) is public here. selfUpdate stays 'managed' (observe, never act) — hallismiley deploys itself from its own CI on green main, so the fleet updater must not swap its image.
